title: 0013 大侠梦0014 以退为进
content_zh:
“切上半斤牛肉，再弄两个小菜，酒也算上他一壶，总不能白说不是！”
人敬我一尺，我敬人一丈。再让洪涛掏钱请算命先生聊天是舍不得的，但请对方吃顿便饭却不肉疼，哪怕花费的更多。
“官爷放心，他若是敢胡说八道小人第一个不答应！哎……掌柜的，二楼常房官爷一位了呐……”
这下伙计算是笑开花了，看起来他和算命先生肯定有业务往来，能为商业伙伴赚上一顿酒菜说着也硬气。当下抢先两步撩开门帘冲着里面就是一嗓子，嘹亮且悠长，和唱戏的差不多。
所谓常房，就是中房。普通客栈的房间大体上分为三类，最豪华的叫官房或者上房，属于套间，家具摆设一应俱全，和后世五星级酒店行政套房一个意思。通常是带家眷的官员、富商居住，价格比较贵，每天要1钱银子上下。
下面一档就是常房，也称中房。一般为单间，有的带后窗户有的不带，设置了简单家具，相当于后世的酒店标间。只要不是囊中羞涩，出远门的一般都会选择，每天要2、30文钱。
最低房型叫通铺，也就是下房。顾名思义，房间里有张大通铺，可以睡几个或十几个人，每人几文钱即可。
都官爷了，再怎么落魄那也是有编制的，当然不能睡大通铺。这一点伙计看得更准，如果只有大通铺，那洪涛宁可找个庙宇在门洞里忍一宿也坚决不凑合。
“贫道魏长风，见过官爷！”
洪涛只跟着掌柜的到二楼房间里看了眼就回到一楼，找了张靠角落还临窗的桌子坐下。随着牛肉、凉菜和两壶温酒摆上桌，一抹仙风道骨也飘然而至。
来人不胖不瘦、不高不矮、长脸浓眉、三缕长髯飘在胸前，眼睛不大不小、表情不卑不亢，道袍浆洗得掉了颜色但很干净整洁。看上去四十岁左右，手脸的皮肤饱经风霜洗礼。
“道长请坐，某唤你来并无要事，只想听听此地风土人情。酒菜简陋了些，莫要嫌弃。”洪涛没起身，只是拱了拱手，然后做个请的手势，简单说明了来意。
“不知官爷在何处高就？”道士也没客气，依言坐在了对面，没怎么关注桌上的酒菜，先询问主顾身份。
“刑部书笔吏，常在庙堂内很少出门。今日碰巧公干路过此地，长夜漫漫孑然一身，故想找个人闲聊，不知道长可有空闲？”
洪涛没有道出真实身份，选了个刑部小吏身份掩饰。其实他想说兵马司的，那样更符合自己的气质。可惜太不熟悉了，怕几句话就被问露馅。
“贫道随时都空闲，官爷想问何事？”对于这番说辞道士显然不全信，但不会追问。
“来，边喝边聊！”洪涛没有马上提问，而是举起酒杯隔桌相邀。
“官爷请……”道士拿起酒壶把酒杯满上，高高举起一饮而尽。
洪涛想问什么呢？什么都想问。之前的洪涛几十年都窝在诏狱中，孤身一人，连顶头上司都不认得，见识太少了。自己穿越过来第一要务就是搞清楚这个时代的政治、经济、人文大环境，别两眼一抹黑才好为后半生做打算。
但经过今日出城逛了一天，即便没怎么深入市井也收获不少。比如街面上多种商品的价格、一路上村镇治安情况等。对这些问题不是特别急切，只要日后多利用闲暇出来逛逛，谁也不用问就能搞清楚。

“道长可曾修行？”可有一件事没法无师自通，那就是修行的细节。殷云霄说过一些，主要偏向于规则层面，太抽象了。
“……贫道只有淬体下阶，家师修行到了通感上阶，离练气之境只有一步之遥。”这个问题让道士感到意外，抬眼盯了几秒钟才开口回答。
“失敬失敬，某也只到了淬体下阶，苦于香火来之不易啊。道长可知识海中的香火突然自行增加是为哪般？”对识海中的异常变化，洪涛始终不太放心，故决定以此为突破口看看能不能解惑。
“识海中的香火突然增加……此事说来话长，牵扯太多，怕是一句两句说不清楚呐。”道士再次感到了意外，已经送到嘴边的酒杯硬生生又放了回去，手捋长髯若有所思。
“某愿闻其详……伙计，再来斤牛肉两壶好酒！”要是能一两句话说清楚洪涛反倒不乐意了，当下又要了些酒菜，摆出不说明白不让走的架势。
“既然官爷想听，那贫道就详细讲讲。人、妖两界若想修行必需香火助力，从九品淬体到一品无垢耗费颇多，绝非常人所能及。
可世间从不缺上三品修士，其中有朝廷供养者也有民间散修，官爷可知他们的香火是从何而来？”
眼见有酒肉可吃，问话之人又不是厌烦之辈，道士终于拿起筷子，先嚼了块牛肉再吃两口菜，这才开始娓娓道来。
这顿饭足足吃了一个多时辰，期间又加了一次酒菜，若不是客栈里的食客们全都走光了，只剩下掌柜和两名伙计眼巴巴的等着上板儿，洪涛怕是还不放道士走呢。
5斤黄酒100文、3斤卤牛肉160文、2斤卤羊肉90文、4盘小菜30，外加6个没馅大馒头，一顿饭花了400多文，相当于两天多的工钱。
但洪涛不觉得亏，如果有时间还想再找类似的人聊聊。因为从魏长风口中不光解开了香火无端增加的疑惑，还找到了一条光明大道，并由此确定了这一世的发展方向，仗剑走天涯！
穿越了那么多次，从市井小民到开国皇帝几乎什么都干过，可每次都是为了人类、族群奋斗得精疲力竭，唯独没有无牵无挂、好恶由心的潇洒走一回。
这次他决定了，不当富翁、不当科学家、不当皇帝也不当土匪头子，而是要当名侠客！看看能不能像武侠小说里那样一人一马行走江湖，醒时快意恩仇，醉时满床星河，好好圆一圆少年时的梦。
凭心而论，在诸多选择中，洪涛认为这个选项的难度是最大的。因为侠客这个物种天生就是反体制的，又不能像揭竿而起那样聚集太多人，只能以一人之力对抗整个体系，真比造反还难。
本来这个选项是排在最后的，怎么轮也轮不到它。可是与魏道士的一番闲聊却如打开了一扇天窗，把很不可能变成了很可能，其根源还要从香火说起。
人、妖两界在百年前鏖战不止，全都伤亡惨重，最终不得不和谈，并由上天见证达成了协议，其中最核心最关键条款就是香火。
从此以后，无论人族还是妖族，想发展壮大就多了个重要参数，香火的多寡。
光有经济和人口不成了，你的士兵没有修行过，在力量、耐力、敏捷方面会大大低于修行过的士兵，哪怕对方只拿根木棍，照样能把你全副武装的精锐打趴下。
想修行就必须依靠香火，想得到香火就要让治下民众由衷信服，把他们的抽象信仰转化成具物香火神力，然后拿来训练士兵，也可以巩固领土，还可以开疆拓土。
但在上天设计这套规则时不知是有意还是疏忽，在如何获得香火上没有做严格规定，以至于除了由朝廷控制的寺庙道观官府等机构能获得香火之外，群体和个人也能获得，且不受任何人、任何组织监控。

通俗点说，每个人都有机会获得香火。比如你令人由衷信服和崇敬，每多一个人，每个月就能多一份香火。再比如宗祠家庙，常年受本族众祭拜，也可以获得香火。
那怎么才算被由衷信服崇敬呢？没标准，不光魏道士说不出来，朝廷和皇帝也没法严格界定，只有个范围。
如果仅仅是通过信仰获得香火，洪涛也不会去琢磨仗剑走天涯的梦。但道士说了，当官的施政清明、读书的文章通透、将军士兵奋勇杀敌，只要被世人敬仰纪念就有可能获得香火，甚至青楼里唱曲的姑娘都在这个范畴之内。
content_en:
"Cut half a catty of beef, make two side dishes, and add a bottle of wine to him. You can't say no for nothing!"
People respect me one foot, and I respect others one foot. Hong Tao couldn't bear to pay for a fortune teller to chat with him again, but it didn't hurt to treat him to a casual meal, even if it cost more.
"Don't worry, sir. If he dares to talk nonsense, the villain will be the first to refuse! Hey... the shopkeeper is the official on the second floor..."
This guy was smiling broadly. It seemed like he must have had business dealings with the fortune teller, and he was confident that he could earn a meal for his business partners. Immediately, he took the first two steps to lift the door curtain and let out a voice inside. It was loud and long, almost like an opera singer.
The so-called regular room is the middle room. Rooms in ordinary inns are generally divided into three categories. The most luxurious is called the official room or upper room, which is a suite with all the furniture and furnishings. It is the same as the executive suite of a five-star hotel in later generations. Usually it is the residence of officials and wealthy businessmen with their families, and the price is relatively expensive, about 1 yuan of silver per day.
The next level is the regular room, also known as the middle room. They are generally single rooms, some with rear windows and some without, and equipped with simple furniture, equivalent to standard hotel rooms in later generations. As long as they are not short of money, people who travel far away will usually choose it, which costs 2 to 30 cents a day.
The lowest room type is called Tongbu, which is the lower room. As the name suggests, there is a big bunk in the room, which can sleep a few or a dozen people for a few cents per person.
Even if you are an official, no matter how downcast you are, you still have a system. Of course, you can't sleep in Datongbu. The man saw this more accurately. If there was only Datongpu, Hong Tao would rather find a temple and endure the night in the doorway than make do with it.
"Wei Changfeng, a poor man, has met the official!"
Hong Tao just followed the shopkeeper to the room on the second floor and took a look before returning to the first floor and sitting down at a table in the corner next to the window. As the beef, cold dishes and two pots of warm wine were placed on the table, a hint of immortality also appeared.
The person who came was neither fat nor thin, neither tall nor short, with a long face and thick eyebrows, three strands of long beard floating on his chest, eyes that were neither big nor small, and an expression that was neither humble nor overbearing. The color of the Taoist robe had been washed away by starch, but it was clean and tidy. He looks about forty years old, and the skin on his hands and face has been weathered.
"Taoist Priest, please sit down. I have nothing important to do with you. I just want to hear about the customs and customs of this place. The food and wine are a bit simple, so don't dislike it." Hong Tao did not stand up, but just cupped his hands, and then made a gesture of invitation, briefly explaining his purpose.
"I wonder where the official is promoted?" The Taoist priest was not polite and sat across from him as he was told. He didn't pay much attention to the food and wine on the table and first asked about the identity of the patron.
"A clerk in the Ministry of Punishment often stays in the temple and seldom goes out. I happened to pass by here today on business, and I was alone for a long night, so I wanted to find someone to chat with. I wonder if I have any free time?"
Hong Tao did not reveal his true identity and chose to hide his identity as a junior official in the Ministry of Justice. In fact, he wanted to go to the Military and Horse Division, as that would be more in line with his temperament. It's a pity that I'm so unfamiliar, and I'm afraid that my secret will be revealed after just a few words.
"The poor Taoist is free at any time. What do you want to ask me?" The Taoist obviously didn't believe this statement, but he would not ask further.
"Come, let's chat while drinking!" Hong Tao did not ask immediately, but raised his glass to invite him across the table.
"My lord, please..." The Taoist priest picked up the jug, filled the wine glass, raised it high and drank it all in one gulp.
What does Hong Tao want to ask? I want to ask everything. The previous Hong Tao spent decades in prison, alone, not even recognizing his immediate boss, and had very little experience. The first thing you need to do when you travel back in time is to understand the political, economic, and humanistic environment of this era, and don't take it for granted so that you can plan for the rest of your life.
But after a day of walking around the city today, I gained a lot even though I didn’t go deep into the market. For example, the prices of various commodities on the street, the security situation in villages and towns along the way, etc. These questions are not particularly urgent. As long as you use your free time to hang out in the future, no one will be able to figure them out without asking.
"Have you ever practiced Taoism?"One thing that cannot be learned without a teacher is the details of spiritual practice. Yin Yunxiao said something, mainly focusing on the rules level, which is too abstract.
"...The poor Taoist only has the lower level of body tempering, and the master has reached the upper level of synaesthesia. He is only one step away from the realm of Qi training." This question surprised the Taoist priest, and he raised his eyes for a few seconds before answering.
"Disrespect, I have only reached the lower level of body tempering, and I am suffering from the hard-earned incense. Master Taoist, can you explain why the incense in the sea of ​​​​knowledge suddenly increased on its own?" Hong Tao was still uneasy about the abnormal changes in the sea of ​​​​consciousness, so he decided to use this as a breakthrough to see if he could solve the puzzle.
"The incense in the sea of ​​​​consciousness suddenly increased... This matter is a long story and involves too much. I'm afraid I can't explain it clearly in a sentence or two." The Taoist priest was surprised again. He put the wine glass that had been brought to his mouth abruptly back, stroking his long beard thoughtfully.
"I'd like to hear the details... Man, here's another catty of beef and two jugs of good wine!" Hong Tao wouldn't be happy if he could explain it clearly in one or two sentences. He immediately ordered some more food and drinks, showing off that he wouldn't let him go unless he explained clearly.
"Since the official wants to hear it, let me explain it in detail. If you want to practice in the human and demon realms, you need the help of incense. Going from the ninth level of body tempering to the first level of unsullied requires a lot of money, which is definitely beyond the reach of ordinary people.
But there is no shortage of third-grade monks in the world. Among them are those supported by the imperial court and some among the private sector. Does the official know where their incense comes from? "
Seeing that there was wine and meat to eat, and the person asking the question was not a bored person, the Taoist priest finally picked up his chopsticks, chewed a piece of beef first, then took two bites of vegetables, and then began to talk.
The meal lasted for more than an hour, during which time there was additional food and wine. If not for all the diners in the inn, leaving only the shopkeeper and two waiters waiting eagerly to be served, Hong Tao might not have let the Taoist go.
5 pounds of rice wine costs 100 Wen, 3 pounds of braised beef costs 160 Wen, 2 pounds of braised mutton costs 90 Wen, 4 plates of side dishes cost 30 Wen, plus 6 large unfilled steamed buns. One meal costs more than 400 Wen, which is equivalent to more than two days' wages.
But Hong Tao doesn't feel any loss. If he has time, he would like to talk to similar people again. Because Wei Changfeng’s words not only solved the mystery of the unreasonable increase in incense, but also found a bright road, and thus determined the development direction of this life, and go to the end of the world with a sword!
He has traveled through time so many times, and has done almost everything from common people to the founding emperor of the country, but every time he has struggled to the end of his energy for the sake of humanity and the ethnic group. The only thing he has not been able to do is walk freely and carefree, and have his own likes and dislikes.
This time he decided not to be a rich man, a scientist, an emperor, or a bandit leader, but to be a knight! Let’s see if we can travel the rivers and lakes with one person and one horse like in the martial arts novels. When we wake up, we will enjoy our grudges. When we are drunk, our bed will be full of stars. Let’s fulfill our childhood dream.
Frankly speaking, among the many choices, Hong Tao believes that this option is the most difficult. Because knights are a species that is inherently anti-system, and they cannot gather too many people like in an uprising. They can only fight against the entire system with the power of one person, which is really more difficult than rebellion.
Originally, this option was ranked last, and no matter how many turns it was, it would not be available. However, a casual chat with Taoist Wei opened a skylight, turning the very unlikely into a very possible one. The root of the problem starts with incense.
A hundred years ago, the human and demon worlds fought fiercely, and both suffered heavy casualties. In the end, they had to negotiate for peace, and God witnessed the agreement reached. The core and most critical clause was incense.
From then on, no matter whether the human race or the demon race, if they want to develop and grow, there will be an important parameter, the amount of incense.
Just having an economy and population is not enough. Your soldiers who have not practiced martial arts will be much lower than those who have practiced martial arts in terms of strength, endurance, and agility. Even if the opponent only holds a wooden stick, they can still knock down your fully armed elite.
If you want to practice cultivation, you must rely on incense. If you want to get incense, you must convince the people under your rule and smoke them.The belief in elephants is transformed into physical incense and divine power, which can then be used to train soldiers, consolidate territory, and expand territory.
However, when God designed this set of rules, whether intentionally or negligently, there were no strict regulations on how to obtain incense. Therefore, in addition to temples, Taoist temples, government agencies and other institutions controlled by the imperial court, groups and individuals can also obtain incense, and it is not monitored by anyone or any organization.
To put it simply, everyone has the opportunity to obtain incense. For example, if you are sincerely convinced and admired, every additional person will provide you with more incense every month. Another example is ancestral temples, which are worshiped by members of the clan all year round and can also receive incense.
So how can you be considered to be sincerely convinced and admired? There is no standard. Not only the Taoist priest Wei cannot explain it, but the court and the emperor cannot strictly define it. There is only a range.
If he only obtained incense through faith, Hong Tao would not dream of traveling to the end of the world with a sword. But the Taoist priests said that as long as an official's governance is clear, his reading is clear, and his generals and soldiers fight bravely against the enemy, as long as they are respected and commemorated by the world, they may be rewarded with incense. Even girls who sing in brothels are included in this category.
